text:
The abstract outlines the overall potential of extracellular vesicles and exosomes, emphasizes the heterogeneity of EVs, and reviews conventional and emerging isolation/characterization strategies—including microfluidic approaches and commercial kits. It discusses the strengths and limitations of these methods but does not propose or evaluate any integration of deep learning models, convolutional neural networks, acoustofluidic technology, or advanced imaging/spectroscopic pipelines for exosome diagnostics. Consequently, the candidate hypothesis involving CNNs and acoustofluidic technology is not presented or supported as the study’s main hypothesis.

VERDICT: REJECT
